goal_text: Go goroutine leak (5 steps): (1) list goroutines spawned, (2) find unbuffered send blocking forever, (3) quantify stuck workers for input n=3, (4) fix with context cancel or buffer, (5) prove termination invariant.
ground_truth: Unbuffered ch: n sends block until n receives; if one goroutine never received ordering can deadlock with scheduling; n=3 expect sum 6 if completes; fix buffered ch size n; invariant: sends==receives before return.
